bug.title: Report a problem
bug.whatHint: What were you doing, and what did you expect to happen?
bug.tooShort: Tell us in a few words what happened.
bug.shotNote: It shows what was on your screen. Turn it off if it shows something private.
bug.shotAlt: Your screen when you tapped Report a problem
bug.noShot: We couldn't take a picture of the screen. You can add one of your own.
bug.badPicture: That picture couldn't be used. Try another one.
bug.alsoSent: Also sent, to help us fix it
bug.sentDevice: Your phone or computer, browser and screen size
bug.sentNetwork: Your connection: online or not, its speed and Data saver
bug.sentLog: The app's last errors and the pages you opened
bug.sentLearning: Your app settings and how many lessons you finished
bug.thanks: Thank you. We got your report.
bug.thanksBody: Its number is {id}. Our team reads every report.
bug.queued: Saved on this device. It will be sent when you're back online.
bug.tooMany: You've sent several reports just now. Try again in a few minutes.
bug.failed: We couldn't send it. Try again.
